args.sql:
WITH performance_delta AS (
    SELECT 
        sp.rectrace AS trace_id,
        sp.resptime AS actual_response_time,
        sp.loadscore AS load_score,
        sp.perfscore AS performance_score,
        (sp.perfscore - sp.loadscore) AS performance_delta,
        s.typelabel AS category,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.typelabel ORDER BY sp.resptime) AS response_time_rank
    FROM 
        news.systemperformance AS sp
    JOIN 
        news.sessions AS s ON sp.seshlink = s.seshkey
    WHERE 
        sp.resptime > 100
)
SELECT 
    trace_id,
    actual_response_time,
    load_score,
    performance_score,
    performance_delta,
    response_time_rank,
    category
FROM 
    performance_delta
ORDER BY actual_response_time DESC;
